messages:
maya: Quick proposal — add a compact smoke + regression gate for quantized bring-up (int8/int4). Goal: catch obvious quality regressions early and avoid noisy canary rollbacks. TL;DR: automated eval-harness run + prompt-level flip detector + latency check — fail canary if any hard rule trips.

maya: Proposed hard rules: 
- overall accuracy delta <= 2% relative to fp16 baseline on primary suites (MMLU/PIQA/BBH aggregate).
- no prompt-level classification flips > 1% on critical safety/ops prompt set (safety-core.json).
- instruction-following rate (inst-follow score) >= 0.97 * baseline.
- latency: p95 increase < 30% and p95 <= 200ms for hosted tier targets.
- model must pass sample smoke hallucination checks (answer contains numeric contradictions flagged).

tom: sounds sensible. For the "critical" prompts, can we keep that list <500 prompts? ops teams want reproducible audit.

maya: yes — we'll use safety-core.json (450 prompts) + a small 50-prompt business-critical set (billing/legal examples). Both stored in /eval/prompt-sets/.

liam: can we run this as part of the intake CI? quick command idea: 
```
# run smoke harness for candidate vs baseline
python -m eval.harness \ 
  --candidate ./models/candidate_{{sha}} \ 
  --baseline ./models/fp16_baseline \ 
  --suites smoke,regressions \ 
  --quant int8 \ 
  --out ./results/candidate_{{sha}}.json
```

sophia: will the harness produce a per-prompt diff so we can triage the worst regressions?

eval-bot: smoke run complete — candidate: sha=abc123, quant=int8. Summary: MMLU: -1.3% (PASS, <=2%), PIQA: -0.8% (PASS), inst-follow: 0.985 (PASS), safety flips: 0.2% (PASS), latency p95: +18% (PASS). Full report: https://internal/eval/reports/abc123

liam: nice. if any single criterion fails we should block canary. For softer degradations (e.g., 2-5% accuracy drop) we should require an explicit product signoff and expanded eval set.

maya: agreed. I'll add two outcomes to the intake flow: 
- HARD FAIL -> stop canary + notify eng-ml/product/security.
- SOFT FAIL (within grace window) -> require product + ml lead signoff and a targeted rollback plan if production regressions are observed.

sophia: who signs off on soft fails?

liam: default: ml-lead + product-pt-of-contact + eng-sre oncall. we can make this configurable per customer for dedicated/private.

maya: I'll update the model-onboard checklist and the intake form to include the exact command, paths, and these thresholds. Will open a tiny PR and tag @tom for review. :thumbsup:
